reason: A DSH compaction plugin that reduces conversation context through a local deterministic compiler or configured remote Responses API compaction, with optional LLM fallback and per-session state persistence.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 提供对话上下文压缩，通过本地确定性编译器或配置的 Responses API 减少历史内容，并支持可选的 LLM 回退与会话状态持久化。
summaries.en: Provides DSH conversation compaction using a deterministic local compiler or a configured Responses API, with optional LLM fallback and per-session state persistence.

capabilities: Compacts conversation history using a deterministic local compiler
Can call configured Responses API endpoints for remote compaction
Can optionally invoke the native LLM summarizer as a fallback
Persists remote compaction state per session
Provides replay of persisted opaque compaction history for compatible requests
